sections.content:
<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def get_blue_positions(frame):
    seg = frame.segmentation
    positions = []
    for n in seg['nodes']:
        if n['color'] == 'S':
            positions.append((n['boundary'][0][0], n['boundary'][0][1]))
    positions.sort()
    return tuple(positions)

# Check current state
current_pos = get_blue_positions(current_frame)
print(f"Current blue positions: {current_pos}")

# Check all nodes
seg = current_frame.segmentation
print(f"\nAll nodes:")
for n in seg['nodes']:
    print(f"  id={n['id']}, color={n['color']}, pixels={n['pixels']}, hash={n['hash'][:8]}, boundary={n['boundary'][:2]}...")

# Check white cells
for n in seg['nodes']:
    if n['color'] == 'W':
        print(f"\nWhite cell: pixels={n['pixels']}, boundary={n['boundary']}")

# Try moving squares to the head position
# Head is around rows 10-20, cols 20-43
# Let me try moving UP multiple times
print(f"\nMoving UP...")
for i in range(10):
    result = action(['UP'])
    pos = get_blue_positions(current_frame)
    print(f"  UP {i+1}: {pos}, gameplay_changed={last_action_result.get('gameplay_changed')}")
    if last_action_result.get('level_completed'):
        print("LEVEL COMPLETED!")
        break
    if last_action_result.get('game_over'):
        print("GAME OVER - pressing SPACE to reset")
        action(['SPACE'])
        break
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
